review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines a bridge from smooth concordance to topological concordance: `Concordance.toTopologicalConcordance`, its coercion lemma, `topologicallyConcordant`, and an existential corollary. All of these are TauCeti-internal concepts. A grep of Mathlib for "Concordan" found only unrelated hits (the word "concordant" in tactic and algebra files), so Mathlib has no concordance notion to compete with. The file adds no new concept of its own. It only converts between two existing relations in this library, and I did not read those definitions. I found no competing duplicate of a Mathlib concept.
